open_file_with_pathmanager: open a file using PathManager.open to read or write with iopath or local fallback
copy_file_with_pathmanager: copy a file from source to destination using PathManager.copy with optional overwrite
check_path_exists: check if a file or directory exists using PathManager.exists with iopath support
list_directory_contents: list files in a directory using PathManager.ls with iopath or os fallback
create_directories_recursively: create nested directories using PathManager.mkdirs with iopath or os.makedirs fallback
